text:
Alex: quick sync — Pavo enterprise trial. cutover target 03/28. we need: final list of integration deliverables, eng owners for each item, and who will review the connector PRs. can SEs + eng owners ack?
Priya: ack from SE side. deliverables i have: sample webhook schema, auth flow docs, staging certs, and load test results. will post checklist by EOD. tagging @Jorge for connector review.
Jorge: got it. can pick up PR reviews after 11am PT tomorrow. which PR is first?
Priya: thanks. first PR is #5423 — connector + typed responses. small but needs KV cache change review. https://git.internal/r/repo/pull/5423
Mei: quick note — the connector change touches the runtime config. I need a JIRA ticket for the infra-approved migration before I can greenlight. please file and link to PR.
Alex: Mei good call. Priya can you create the infra ticket and add migration notes? we need migration window in the cutover plan.
Priya: will create JIRA INFRA-1297 now and link. also adding staging test steps.
Sam: infra heads-up — firewall rules for Pavo's staging IPs are required. Sam (eng-infra) will be the owner for getting security sign-off. ETA 48h once ticket is in JIRA.
Priya: @Sam thanks. include port 443 egress + IP range. we may also need an internal route for the ingest queue.
Sam: noted. I'll ping sec and platform on the ticket.
Alex: success criteria for trial (proposed): 99th perc latency < 350ms for 8k token prompts, ingestion throughput >= 120 reqs/min, and no data exfil beyond agreed VPC boundaries. SEs: confirm these match customer expectations.
Priya: they want <400ms 95th, and throughput target of 100 rps during demo windows. i'll reconcile with your numbers and post final.
Jorge: small code-review note: please include a regression test for long context handling. see snippet I added to PR comments:
```
# test: long context
assert model.respond(prefix * 5).tokens > 4096
```
Mei: also ensure the runtime config change has a fallback env var to disable the new KV path in case we need quick rollback.
Alex: good ops safety call. add `REDWOOD_KV_FALLBACK=true` as a toggle in the docs.
Priya: checklist update posted: https://jira.internal/browse/INFRA-1297 and attached staging run logs. linking PR #5423.
Jorge: started review on #5423, left two inline comments about concurrency and a small nits. will finish by EOD tomorrow.
Sam: security confirms firewall exceptions once ticket has the required IPs + owner. leaving note for compliance review as well.
deploy-bot: scheduled cutover window created: 2026-03-28T01:00-03:00 (UTC) — created by Alex.
Alex: final ask — please react with :thumbsup: when you own an item. i'll assemble the cutover doc on Monday and share the runbook.
Priya: :thumbsup: webhook schema owner, staging tests owner.
Jorge: :thumbsup: connector CR + regression tests owner.
Mei: :thumbsup: runtime config + rollback toggle owner.
Sam: :thumbsup: infra/firewall owner.
Alex: thanks all — i'll publish the cutover runbook with owners and rollback steps by Monday 10am PT. if anything blocks earlier, drop notes here and i'll escalate.
